Messages.Body:
Can I gain more than one maneuver from manuever/strikes (like thrown gate) if I
play multiple strikes?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <19980117004...@ladder02.news.aol.com>, VampChamp1
<vampc...@aol.com> writes

>Can I gain more than one maneuver from manuever/strikes (like thrown gate) if I
>play multiple strikes?

No. There is no way to perform 'multiple' strikes at the same time
which is the only way that you could use the maneuver from a Thrown Gate
and an Aid from Bats played during the same Choose Range step.

Using a manuever with a strike card (like a gun, or those cards)
requires you to then choose that strike for the FIRST strike you do.
You can't use two and ignore one or use two and say "Well, I'll use one
on an additional strike".

Therefore, you can only use ONE maneuver-strike card during any choose
range step (otherwise you'd commit yourself to doing two strikes which
isn't possible).
